scope: Original-weight shared-core AR, same provider with different dense selector; not independent model quality

model_identity: Unchanged file/stat witnesses bound to retained original hashes; no model conversion
thread_scope: Sampled OS child threads include HIP/runtime/loading/retirement; one device dispatcher, users are sequences

public_artifacts.scope: Pooled figure uses qualified C native statistics and renderer; GPU numerical binaries stay frozen5a377aa

limitations: Same model/provider numerical graph with different dense selector; not independent model quality or Gufo HTTP equivalence

OS file cache is uncontrolled; no cold-loading or stable performance parity claim
Resource values are sampled observations, not allocation-exact GPU accounting
No GPU failure among18 arms; preparation failures are preserved in separate host receipt
